# FerroelectricSynapticDevices

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Hardware synaptic elements using ferroelectric materials to store analog weights in a non-volatile manner, enabling personalized spiking neural network implementations. Offers a scalable, energy-efficient physical substrate for in-network neuromorphic computing, supporting adaptive and personalized learning directly at the edge.
